description: Defines the Workspace Monitoring configuration of the Monitoring item: which diagnostic signals are collected and which stores they are routed into.

$schema.description: The URI of the schema that validates this document.

dataCollectionSettings.description: The source to destination routing sets of this Monitoring item. Exactly one routing set is supported. When absent, data collection is not configured.

operationsAgent.description: The Operations Agent component of this Monitoring item. When absent, the Operations Agent is not enabled. Requires dataCollectionSettings to be present.

DataCollectionSetting.description: A routing set that pairs the collected diagnostic sources with the destinations they are written to.

sources.description: The diagnostic signals collected by this routing set.

destinations.description: The stores that the collected diagnostic signals are written to.

MonitoringSources.description: The diagnostic signals collected by a routing set.

workspaceDiagnostics.description: The workspace diagnostics signal collected from the items in the workspace.

WorkspaceDiagnosticsSource.description: The set of workspace items that diagnostics are collected from.

mode.description: The collection scope. 'All' collects diagnostics from every supported item in the workspace.

MonitoringDestinations.description: The stores that the collected diagnostic signals are written to.

eventhouse.description: The Eventhouse (KQL) store that this routing set writes into.

eventStream.description: An additional Eventstream destination for this routing set. Supported with both the Auto and Linked Eventhouse ownership models.

EventhouseDestination.description: The Eventhouse (KQL) store of a routing set. It is either provisioned and owned by this Monitoring item, or owned by another Monitoring item that this item links to.

AutoEventhouseDestination.description: An Eventhouse that this Monitoring item provisions and owns as a child.

mode.description: The Eventhouse ownership model. 'Auto' means this Monitoring item provisions and owns the Eventhouse.

LinkedEventhouseDestination.description: An Eventhouse owned by another Monitoring item that this Monitoring item routes into. It is referenced rather than owned, so deleting this item does not delete it.

mode.description: The Eventhouse ownership model. 'Linked' means the Eventhouse is owned by another Monitoring item.

parentMonitoringItem.description: The Monitoring item that owns the target Eventhouse. The Eventhouse is resolved from that item when the route is bound.

EventStreamDestination.description: The Eventstream destination of a routing set.

customEndpoint.description: The Eventstream custom endpoint that the collected telemetry is streamed to.

CustomEndpointDestination.description: Whether the collected telemetry is streamed to an external custom endpoint.

enabled.description: Whether streaming to the external custom endpoint is enabled. Streaming is off when the containing object is absent.

OperationsAgent.description: The Operations Agent provisioned as a child of this Monitoring item.

enabled.description: Whether the Operations Agent is enabled. Once enabled it cannot be disabled.
